Answer: B
Reason: The serial chest X-rays demonstrate a progression from multifocal nodular opacities to extensive, diffuse bilateral fluffy infiltrates and consolidations over the 14-month period. This radiographic pattern is characteristic of the diffuse pneumonic type of bronchioloalveolar carcinoma (now classified as invasive mucinous adenocarcinoma), which indicates aggressive multinodular disease with a poor prognosis.
